title: Hinomori Shizuku — Profile Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I'll be capping things off for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, for my self-intro...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Umm... What should I talk about?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I was thinking about it while the others were doing theirs, but I haven't been able to get my thoughts together...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Still, I suppose...
I should tell that story.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I used to be in a group called Cheerful * Days before I joined MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There, I convinced myself that I had to be the “perfect idol”, and act like the person everyone wanted me to be.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I could only keep doing that for so long, and I eventually ended up leaving Cheerful * Days...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After that, I became an idol for MORE MORE JUMP! However, I had trouble expressing who I really was...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was worried that my fans from when I was with Cheerful * Days would feel betrayed if they ever saw my true self...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But everyone in MORE MORE JUMP! encouraged me to just be myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And now, people watching our streams are commenting how they like seeing the real me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I'm no longer afraid, and why I'm able to have fun as an idol alongside the others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, thank you all very much...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I apologize for getting sidetracked. I was supposed to be introducing myself, wasn't I?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So, um...
For my self-intro...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? That works just fine...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What about the comments...? Let's see...
“I have a better understanding of you now, Shizuku!”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “I love how you cherish both your past experiences and the fans of the old you”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
I love how thoughtful you all are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, that'll be...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, right. Thank you, Haruka!
I was forgetting something very important!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, everyone, please listen.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Here to bring you a burst of happiness. I'm Shizuku Hinomori from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still just getting on my feet as an idol, and I may stumble along the way...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we're going to keep spreading as much hope as we can. So, we'll be looking forward to your continued support.

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/scenario/profile/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
